popper-class.description: custom class name for the popup menu
popper-class.description_zh: 弹出菜单的自定义类名

:show-timeout.description: timeout before showing a sub-menu(inherit `show-timeout` of the menu by default.)
:show-timeout.description_zh: 展开 sub-menu 的延时（默认继承自 menu 的 show-timeout）

:hide-timeout.description: timeout before hiding a sub-menu(inherit `hide-timeout` of the menu by default.)
:hide-timeout.description_zh: 收起 sub-menu 的延时（默认继承自 menu 的 hide-timeout）

teleported.description: whether popup menu is teleported to the body, the default is true for the level one SubMenu, false for other SubMenus
teleported.description_zh: 是否将弹出菜单插入至 body 元素，对于嵌套的 SubMenu，默认 true 用于一级 SubMenu，false 用于其他 SubMenu

:popper-offset.description: offset of the popper (overrides the `popper` of menu)
:popper-offset.description_zh: 弹出菜单的偏移量（覆盖 menu 的 popper-offset 属性）

expand-close-icon.description: Icon when menu are expanded and submenu are closed, `expand-close-icon` and `expand-open-icon` need to be passed together to take effect
expand-close-icon.description_zh: 菜单展开且子菜单关闭时的图标，`expand-close-icon` 和 `expand-open-icon` 需要一起传入才会生效

expand-open-icon.description: Icon when menu are expanded and submenu are opened, `expand-open-icon` and `expand-close-icon` need to be passed together to take effect
expand-open-icon.description_zh: 菜单展开且子菜单打开时的图标，`expand-open-icon` 和 `expand-close-icon` 需要一起传入才会生效

collapse-close-icon.description: Icon when menu are collapsed and submenu are closed, `collapse-close-icon` and `collapse-open-icon` need to be passed together to take effect
collapse-close-icon.description_zh: 菜单收起且子菜单关闭时的图标，`collapse-close-icon` 和 `collapse-open-icon` 需要一起传入才会生效

collapse-open-icon.description: Icon when menu are collapsed and submenu are opened, `collapse-open-icon` and `collapse-close-icon` need to be passed together to take effect
collapse-open-icon.description_zh: 菜单收起且子菜单打开时的图标，`collapse-open-icon` 和 `collapse-close-icon` 需要一起传入才会生效

typeDetail.MenuSelectEvent: (index: string, indexPath: string[], item: MenuItemClicked, routerResult?: Promise<void | NavigationFailure>) => void
typeDetail.MenuItemRegistered: { index: string, indexPath: string[], active: boolean }
typeDetail.MenuItemClicked: { index: string, indexPath: string[], route?: RouteLocationRaw }
